desc: 她忘记了自己上一次度过生日是什么时候。今天，睁开三只眼睛的瞬间，迎接她的是柔和的晨光，是箱中的晨曦，而非黑暗与死寂。这样的幸福已让她落下泪来。|《湖边的女人》记得一个独特的日子，在寂静落灰的仓库中，一只神秘学发条钟忽然大声鸣唱，引起一片骚动。尽管事后她失望地得知，这只是一次神秘学意外，并非偶遇意识唤醒者同胞，但那片刻喧嚣在记忆中显得温暖而喜悦。|一场温馨、完美的艺术鉴赏会在箱中举行。《湖边的女人》安坐于荒原的青草地上，一整天同伙伴们交流着线与面的多角度诠释，展望艺术的未来。并非所有人都能欣赏她的形式，也并非所有人欣赏的艺术都能被她理解。但是能聚在一道，共享如苏醒时那般美丽的风景，这便弥足珍贵。
desc2: 承载了珍贵记忆的彩色相片，可用于邀请此神秘学家。

character_data.text:
意识唤醒者艺术品，展出于20世纪10年代，参展时长93年，诞生自4月7日春。参展于法国巴黎，曾巡展于世界各地，后收录于圣洛夫基金会。

尺寸：46×36×1 1/2in.
介质：立体主义
香调：水生调 香柠檬 薄荷 天竺葵 矿物质
灵感：本质的映像[木] 画中观者

character_data.title: 绘画的边界
character_data.text:
简单的木制画框，于1914年后的某个时日装配。
在后续颠沛的生涯中，木框不慎被特殊的蓝色油彩沾染：顽固、粘稠、难以清理，但并非不可去除。
是画需要画框，还是画框需要画？在漫长的仓库生涯中，这是受访者排遣寂寞的思考题目之一，她已迫不及待想同我们的读者交换见解。

character_data.title: “多角度的视野”
character_data.text:
受访者的眼睛存在于同一平面，看向不同方向。无论哪一只，都欢迎来访者与自己对视。目光相接，便可碰撞出思绪，画幅将因观者的存在获得意义。
受访者认为，对自身的解读方式是多样的。保持多角度的视野，这是她所喜爱，但并非唯一正解的欣赏建议。

character_data.title: “1912年春”
character_data.text:
受访者所容纳的物品之一，也是她少数欣然容纳之物。
照片定格在某一刻，年轻的画家们向往着用新的主义诠释世界。其后，战争、贫困、新的技法……生活本身令年轻人们分离，他们的名字也早已失落。但在受访者的画中，至今仍收藏着这些面孔。

character_data.title: 多角度描绘
character_data.text:
她眨了眨自己的三只眼睛。
二十世纪的头两个十年，巴黎的咖啡馆中总有鲜花，年轻的艺术家们讨论着绘画与事物的本质：世界变化那样快，传统的、将物体在画布上复现的技艺已臻于完美，但也不再新鲜。在照相机的挑战面前，画笔的意义是什么？
年轻画家们用拆解又重组的线、面、几何体作为答案。
她有七个侧面和一顶漂亮的帽子，还有一泓春天的湖水，它们存在于不同的时间与角度。奔赴巴黎的年轻人兴奋地挥着炭笔，渴望让人类的眼睛在同一瞬间捕捉到这一切。她应当是多角度的、反传统的、真实而又超越真实的、由艺术家和观者共同塑造的。
她记得那间咖啡馆——周遭宁静、优雅，弥漫着咖啡与书籍的香气。谈话声飘了过来，她很高兴有人愿意驻足，看一看在同一个平面呈现的湖泊、云朵，以及白云的本质。
哦，亲爱的朋友，很高兴您也对这种探索感兴趣。立体主义，这个名字意味着……
她多愿意配合谈话，世界是辽阔、幽微又富于趣味的，艺术家能做的有那么多，能够聊的东西有那么多！这里是巴黎，每个人都能谈一谈自己的艺术理想，每个人都可以畅想如何建构自己的世界。
人们驻足，观赏她，买下她。她的声音被淹没了。
美好时代正在远去。
一幅觉醒了意识的画，一幅能够容纳许多、藏匿许多的画。在立体主义之上，她收获了更有趣的含义。

character_data.title: 明日之艺术
character_data.text:
1912年6月X日
我不喜欢巴黎，这里有太多人，太多声音，太多的——东西。关于怎么画画，每个人都有自己的点子。在公寓门口，安托万先生刚刚拉住我高谈阔论一番，告诉我他不喜欢那些小立方体，好像我不点头，他就会立即让我交出这两个月的房租。
我想，在巴黎，最不缺乏的就是答案。但是，问题本身是什么呢？

1912年9月X日
好消息，我有工作了！至少这三个月，我可以在画室教学生基本功，不必担心面包从何而来。
塞缪尔说我昨天盯着一支烟斗坐了十二个小时，他在夸张。

1913年10月X日
我是个傻瓜，我依然不知道该怎么作画。将一碗水果、一把小提琴、一位模特分解成八十个面，然后拍在同一张画布上——这是问题，还是答案？

1914年4月X日
我离开了巴黎……在我后悔之前，我得尽可能走远一点儿。我没跟任何人打招呼。这依然是一种陈词滥调：一次散心——去大自然中寻找灵感。是的，总是大自然。我没有毕加索先生或布拉克先生那样巧妙的大脑，我能做的只有投入陈词滥调之中。
我将去往湖区，愿安纳西湖的碧绿能够告诉我那个答案，或者，告诉我缪斯女神那反复无常的谜面是什么。

1914年5月X日
一片湖，答案是一片湖，问题也是一片湖。
仅此而已。

character_data.title: 为谈话而谈话
character_data.text:
白雪松：就像我之前介绍过的那样，我们的读者想了解真实的你。你可以畅所欲言，我的意思是，放松一点。
《湖边的女人》：是的，谢谢您，我完全明白什么是采访，我只是——哦，请原谅，我只是太激动了！您是为和我谈话而来的，和我……天哪！
白雪松：你很喜欢谈话本身。
《湖边的女人》：我很少有这种机会，女士。您瞧，在来到司辰的箱子之前，我最熟悉的地方是仓库。人们很少想要对一幅画说话。
白雪松：你聆听和经历了许多，读者们会对此好奇的。
《湖边的女人》：真感谢您这样想。让我想想……比起“经历”，也许更准确的词是“旁观”或者“携带”。我为人们藏匿物品——珍贵的与被摒弃的，还有那些不起眼的小玩意。我总是记下它们的故事，因为时光太过漫长。
白雪松：那么你的故事呢？
《湖边的女人》：我的故事无关紧要。但是——
《湖边的女人》：每幅画都希望被看见，希望拥有一个谈话对象。我一直想知道，不同的观众在我之中看到了什么。“我”的完整形象应当在观者的头脑内形成。如果有观众愿意同我说说话，那就更好了！
《湖边的女人》：我有一个话题清单！我们可以聊艺术，或者不同侧面组合的方式，或者春天……

character_voice.name: 初遇
character_voice.content: 噢，噢！您……您真的回应了我的请求！感谢上帝……噢不，感谢司辰！#0|这儿如此、如此完美地适合悬挂一幅画作，甚至比我想象的要更好……#6.98
character_voice.encontent: Oh, oh my! Thank God you let me stay here ... No, indeed, thank YOU, Timekeeper!#0|Look at this place! Isn't it the perfect spot for a frame? This is beyond even my wildest imagination ...#7.51

character_voice.name: 箱中气候
character_voice.content: 那是一个晴朗的下午，一位默默无闻的画家坐在安纳西湖畔。#0|阳光下，那湖仿若玻璃般青绿，#6.25|将光线轻盈、奇异地映射在面前女人的帽檐、眉峰与唇上——#9.76|于是，不一会儿，我便诞生了！#16.45
character_voice.encontent: It was on an afternoon like this. An obscure artist sat by Lac d'Annecy. #0|The water was green and clear as the glass beneath the sunlight, #5.68|reflecting warm light across the model's hat, her brow, and her lips in a truly magical manner ...#10.02|And voila! I was "born" on the canvas!#17.34

character_voice.content: 那是一个晴朗的下午，一位默默无闻的画家坐在安纳西湖畔。#0|阳光下，那湖仿若玻璃般青绿，#6.25|将光线轻盈、奇异地映射在面前女人的帽檐、眉峰与唇上——#9.76|于是，不一会儿，我便诞生了！#16.45

An obscure artist sat by Lac d'Annecy. #0|The water was green and clear as the glass beneath the sunlight, #5.68|reflecting warm light across the model's hat, her brow, and her lips in a truly magical manner ...#10.02|And voila! I was "born" on the canvas!#17.34

character_voice.name: 致未来
character_voice.content: 我猜，未来的沙龙会更欣赏理性明快的线条，#0|他们会使用更复杂的拼贴，或者进行一些真正的社会写实，去描绘工厂、劳动者——#4.12|等等，我似乎说得太多了……其实，现在也不赖！#10.76
character_voice.encontent: In my view, salons of the future will prefer brighter, geometric lines and make greater use of papier collé in their works. #0|Further still, their works will focus more on society itself; its mechanical factories and the alienation of labor ... #8.17|Oh, oh, am I blathering on? Pardonnez-moi, perhaps salons today are not so bad.#16

character_voice.name: 孑立
character_voice.content: 不好意思，我无意打断，#0|但——我想说，您观赏我的姿态，是那么的静谧、优雅，宛若一尊小巧的女神雕塑……#2.12|以至于，我能反过来欣赏您～#9.11
character_voice.encontent: Excusez-moi, I hope you'll pardon the interruption. #0|I wanted to express just how much I adore you appreciating me! Your poise! So serene and elegant, like a goddess in marble ... #3.44|I can hardly tell who is really admiring whom!#12.93

character_voice.name: 问候
character_voice.content: 您、您来了！请坐在这边的软凳上……您今天过得如何？#0|哈哈，您今天的发型也很完美，虽然它被帽子藏了起来……#5.46|不管怎样，司辰，请多陪我聊聊天吧！#10.12
character_voice.encontent: You, you're here! Come, come, have a seat ... How's your day? #0|I adore your hairstyle today, though it's covered up by your hat ... #4.26|Put all that aside, Timekeeper, please, would you speak with me a little longer?#8.16

character_voice.name: 朝晨
character_voice.content: 早安，司辰。看样子，您一定还没用过早餐吧。#0|如果需要的话，我能提供一把随嘴唇曲度而变化边缘的勺子、#3.42|一个偶尔会因愤怒而蒸干液体的杯子，#7.75|以及一把稍潮的1914年产风暴猫屎酸性咖啡豆……#10.25|什么，您说您吃过了？#14.68
character_voice.encontent: Good morning, Timekeeper. Have you had breakfast yet? #0|I happen to have a spoon that automatically adjusts its edge to match the curve of your lips, #3.37|a cup that occasionally vaporizes liquid when angry, #8.84|and some damp Splintercat coffee beans from 1914 ... #12.44|Oh, you already ate?#16.78

character_voice.name: 朝晨
character_voice.content: 早安，司辰。看样子，您一定还没用过早餐吧。#0|如果需要的话，我能提供一把随嘴唇曲度而变化边缘的勺子、#3.42|一个偶尔会因愤怒而蒸干液体的杯子，#7.75|以及一把稍潮的1914年产风暴猫屎酸性咖啡豆……#10.25|什么，您说您吃过了？#14.68
character_voice.encontent: Good morning, Timekeeper. Have you had breakfast yet? #0|I happen to have a spoon that automatically adjusts its edge to match the curve of your lips, #3.37|a cup that occasionally vaporizes liquid when angry, #8.84|and some damp Splintercat coffee beans from 1914 ... #12.44|Oh, you already ate?#16.78

character_voice.name: 信任-朝晨
character_voice.content: 亲爱的司辰，请您凑近……凑近一点，#0|对，正是在这个时刻，光线能在任何情况下、无阴影地折射出您的脸……#3.36|请让我记住它，记住您所有角度的样貌～#9.71
character_voice.encontent: Timekeeper, would you come closer ... a little closer, please ... #0|Right here! That is where the sunshine lights up your face without casting a single shadow from any angle ...#4.97|I want to seal that image in my mind!#13.07

character_voice.name: 夜暮
character_voice.content: 在夜晚宁静的氛围下，我会显得更像一个有延展性的二维空间，#0|所有人都能从中发现某些断裂的时空在瞬间重叠的艺术巧思……#4.94|一切都很恰当！#9.95
character_voice.encontent: When people look at me in the tranquility of the night, #0|they'll find the extendable perspective of space within my two-dimensional image and notice the subtle design of the overlapping fragments ... #3.63|Everything is just as it should be!#13.92

character_voice.name: 信任-夜暮
character_voice.content: 巴黎的晚宴总是这样——#0|他们戴着面具，他们语气浮夸，他们嘲弄万事万物，他们渴求真正的变革……#2|虽然我发现，他们只是将我当成一个“储藏室”，#9.58|但……我偶尔也能得到一些回应……#13.82
character_voice.encontent: The salon in Paris never changes—#0|Those people with masks exaggerating and making fun of everything, yearning for a "true revolution" ... #3.19|I came to realize they only saw me as a means of storing their unwanted things ... #12.35|yet, sometimes my words found an echo ...#18.75

character_voice.name: 帽檐与发鬓
character_voice.content: 噢！您如此热心地凑近……#0|我理解，一个立体的、展示多面视角的头脸是很难理解的……#2.76|但这并非完全没有好处，#7.94|至少，我能向世界表达更多一份的希望、温柔与茫然无措……#9.85
character_voice.encontent: Oh, you've gotten quite close ... #0|I understand it can be difficult to read a polyhedral face ... #2.65|However, there's a silver lining: #7.44|through Cubism I can express both my hope and helplessness in a multi-angular way ...#10.58

character_voice.name: 袖与手
character_voice.content: 我感受过很多双不同的手，#0|有涂着颜料的手，有沾染血腥的手，也有粗糙而凶暴的手……#2.71|但您的手不同，它触摸边缘的时候很凉，却很轻柔……#10.57
character_voice.encontent: I have experienced touch from many different hands. #0|Covered with pigment, with blood, or even darkened with ill intention ...#3.67|But none of them are like yours. Your fingers are both cold and soft ...#10.83

character_voice.name: 衣着与身形
character_voice.content: 噢，是的，您一定也能从中感受到反传统的几何之美，#0|这是对真实世界的重构，也是事物真正的本质……#4.29|什么，您说只是想帮我扶正画框？#8.96
character_voice.encontent: Ou la la, could it be that you've captured the true essence of the world—#0|a reconstruction of reality, symbolizing the beauty of the unconventional ... #4.66|What? You just wanted to straighten my frame?#10.61

character_voice.name: 嗜好
character_voice.content: 从共性上来说，每位画作都喜爱着一个湿度40%、温度20℃左右，#0|以及光照约为150勒克斯的安身之所。#6.42|最好还是有一位能说得上话的观众～#9.82
character_voice.encontent: Generally speaking, the ideal residence of any painting should maintain a humidity level of around 40%, a temperature of 20 ℃, #0|and a light intensity of 150 lux. #10.2|But for me, an ideal residence simply must include someone to chat with!#13.04

character_voice.encontent: Generally speaking, the ideal residence of any painting should maintain a humidity level of around 40%, a temperature of 20 ℃, #0|and a light intensity of 150 lux. #10.2|But for me, an ideal residence simply must include someone to chat with!#13.04

character_voice.name: 赞赏
character_voice.content: 原来，您不只是为我提供住所，#0|而是为所有来投奔您的诈骗师、杀手和超忆症患者都预备了容身之处……#2.86|您，一位真正的艺术品收藏家！#9.4
character_voice.encontent: You didn't just provide a home for me, #0|but for every killer, con artist, and hyperthymesia patient who has sought refuge with you ... #2.73|You're a true collector!#10.69

character_voice.name: 亲昵
character_voice.content: 我找出了一顶在巴黎皇家宫殿得到的软呢帽，#0|虽然边缘有个小刀造成的缺口，但想必能完美适配您所有的造型。#3.32|请不要问它的来源，只需欣赏便好。#8.74
character_voice.encontent: Look what I found—A fedora from la Palais-Royal. #0|If you ignore the knife mark on the brim, it matches your outfit perfectly. #4.26|Please, it is best you don't know how I got it.#9.11

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 俱乐部后台的黑暗总是多姿多彩，#0|在那里，我至少分辨出了三起盗窃案，一起可能的谋杀案，#2.55|有时还能听到佩雷斯先生的咳嗽，以及老鼠一家摆弄纸板和机器的窸窣声……#6.89|什么，您说佩雷斯先生就是这窝老鼠？！#13.17
character_voice.encontent: Life in the dark backstage of the club was at times quite invigorating. #0|There were at least three major thefts, and I believe even a murder. #5.18|At times I would hear Monsieur Pérez's cough and the rustling of the mice family and some sort of machine ... #9.87|What? You mean to say the mice WERE Monsieur Pérez?!#17.27

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 在重塑中，平先生是一个古雅又高贵的人。#0|在每月固定的日子，他会由内而外地将自身打理一新：#3.6|我时常见他一边用钳子往蟹脸上抹着飘香的马油，一边飒沓流星般远去……#7.94|不一会儿，您就能看到他“崭新”地回来——当然，是换了一副身躯。#14.1
character_voice.encontent: Mr. Taira of the Manus Vindictae always seemed to be a charming and old-fashioned gentleman. #0|Each month, #6.57|I see him applying oil to his crab face with his chelae usually at breakneck speed ... #7.49|And soon enough, he would return with a brand-new look—and by that I mean an entirely new body.#12.46

character_voice.name: 独白
character_voice.content: 吞入无数的作案工具、抹平一切痕迹后，藏起人们最深的秘密……#0|您瞧，我乐意。不过，直到来到您这儿，我才感觉到——#6.36|我，也可以不那么“乐意”的……#12
character_voice.encontent: I once simply accepted that my only purpose was to conceal evidence, murder weapons, or even someone's deepest secrets ... #0|You helped me to realize that I could say no ... #9.58|Maybe I should have long ago.#13.4

character_voice.name: 入队
character_voice.content: 虽……虽然我不擅长，但勉强可以一试……#0
character_voice.encontent: I-It's not my forte, but I will try ...#0

character_voice.name: 战前
character_voice.content: 噢，等等……这是什么情况？#0
character_voice.encontent: Huh ... What's going on here?#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 是那边的先生，对吗？#0
character_voice.encontent: Tu parles bien de la personne là-bas, n'est-ce pas ?#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 按您心意！#0
character_voice.encontent: As you wish!#0

character_voice.name: 择选高阶咒语

character_voice.encontent: The principles of Cubism ...#0

character_voice.name: 择选至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 关乎漂泊的情绪……#0
character_voice.encontent: I am in the mood to wander ...#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 您……能看见我吗？#0
character_voice.encontent: C-can you see me ...?#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 希望您注意到……#0
character_voice.encontent: I hope you notice me ...#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 我必须为您做点什么！#0
character_voice.encontent: Let me do something for you!#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 为了真正的同伴……！#0
character_voice.encontent: For my true friends!#0

character_voice.name: 召唤至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 黑暗中的全部悲苦……#0
character_voice.encontent: All that distress in the darkness ...#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅰ
character_voice.encontent: *whimper*#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 朋友们，这并不好！#0

character_voice.name: 洞悉
character_voice.content: 并不完全是利齿子儿和微尘改变了我，#0|而是您——您提供的住所、人们的友善，#2.73|以及不时能听闻鸟鸣、感受光线洒落在脸庞的生活……是这一切！#6.65
character_voice.encontent: What changed my mind was never the Sharpodonties or Dust. #0|It was you—this place you offer, the kindness of your friends, #4.38|and the life you provide here with the chirping birds and the warm sunlight—all of it was you.#10.07

character_voice.name: 洞悉之底
character_voice.content: 噢！您……如此大费周章，是想去除我身上的靛蓝痕迹吗？#0|老天爷，我必须为此而感激您……毕竟，这便是我真实的模样，#5.37|是在漫长岁月中，#10.73|因为一直被当成垃圾场……#12.17|连我自身都已经遗忘的“真实”。#14.13
character_voice.encontent: Oh! So all these things you've done ... you're trying to remove those indigo marks? #0|Good heavens, I must express my gratitude ... You really wish to bring back my true image. #5.73|Over the years,#12.41|I had begun to see myself as nothing more than a hiding place for unwanted things ... #13.35|I've nearly forgotten what it feels like to simply be ... me.#19.27

skin.name: 《湖边的女人》
skin.skinDescription: 当湖仅仅是湖，当她仅需做她自己。

1353011.content: 每天都能遇到您，真是最幸运的事情！今天也请陪我聊聊天吧！
有微风、有雨、有日出、有夕阳……我可以在荒原里待一整天！
当然，最重要的是，这儿每时每刻都有数不尽的好朋友！
喜欢写小说的女孩、头上有着小蛇的研究员、会制作魔药的大小姐……
她们能陪我说上一天的话。

1353012.content: 我为你准备了一些小礼物，庆祝我们相识的这段时间！
这是我在如愿甘泉旁拾起的盐粒……也许它来自盐封曼德拉？
还有由魔精掉落的绒毛制成的小帽子！
真奇怪，它散发着微尘的味道。
也对，也对……以后咱们还能相处很长很长的时间。
也能在一起经历很多很多的故事！
